belongs_to_collection.name: The Number on the Wall Collection

data.overview: Years after escaping a murderer who abducted him as a boy, Eli Mercer still struggles to build an ordinary life. When his younger sister begins receiving calls through a disconnected phone in her dreams, the siblings follow her visions to a snowbound camp where three missing boys are being hunted by a killer who has returned from the grave.
data.tagline: Some calls come from the other side.
data.title: The Number on the Wall
